title: Adjunct Instructor - Marketing - John Chambers College of Business and Economics
description:
The Department of Marketing in the John Chambers College of
Business and Economics ( 
https://business.wvu.edu/academics/marketing-department/marketing
) at West Virginia University invites applications for part-time
Lecturer positions. Areas of need include undergraduate courses in
marketing.

Qualifications :

Preferred candidates should hold a master's or doctoral degree in
marketing, MBA or a closely related discipline and evidence of
ability to teach effectively. A bachelor's degree plus at least
five (5) years of full-time, relevant professional experience in
the course content area may be considered. Individuals with a
doctoral degree are eligible to teach graduate or undergraduate
courses; individuals with only a bachelor's or master's degree are
eligible to teach undergraduate courses.

Applications will be accepted throughout the year and will be
considered as openings arise. Salary is established on a per-course
basis. While these positions are not anticipated to be
benefits-eligible, individual positions may become
benefits-eligible based on course load - which may vary depending
on departmental need.

Please submit via PDF file (a) a letter of application summarizing
your teaching qualifications, (b) your curriculum vitae, and (c)
contact information for two individuals who can provide letters of
recommendation.
